  function isEligible(el){
    if(!el||el.tagName!=='TEXTAREA')return false;
    if(el.matches&&el.matches('[data-rc973-fixed-height="1"]'))return false;
    if(el.closest&&el.closest('#loadListDoc,.rc390-paper,.index209-signature-dialog'))return false;

  function cssMinHeight(el){
    var n=0;
    try{n=parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(el).minHeight)||0}catch(_){}
    return Number.isFinite(n)?n:0;
  }

  function resizeTextarea(el){
    if(!isEligible(el))return false;
    el.setAttribute('data-rc973-autogrow','1');
    el.style.setProperty('max-height','none','important');
    el.style.setProperty('overflow-y','hidden','important');
    el.style.setProperty('height','auto','important');
    var target=Math.max(cssMinHeight(el),Number(el.scrollHeight||0));
    if(target>0)el.style.setProperty('height',Math.ceil(target)+'px','important');
    return true;
  }

  function scan(root){
    var scope=root&&root.querySelectorAll?root:document;
    if(root&&root.nodeType===1&&isEligible(root))resizeTextarea(root);
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(scope.querySelectorAll('textarea'),resizeTextarea);
  }

  function runScheduled(){
    scheduled=0;
    scan(document);
  }

  function schedule(){

    clearTimeout(delayed);
    delayed=setTimeout(function(){delayed=0;scan(document)},60);
  }

  document.addEventListener('input',function(ev){
    if(isEligible(ev.target))resizeTextarea(ev.target);
  },true);
  document.addEventListener('change',function(ev){
    if(isEligible(ev.target))resizeTextarea(ev.target);
  },true);
